body:
## Summary

Refs #32 (FA-031). Closure is a separate step; the GitHub issue stays OPEN.

The upstream Flyway collision checker compared only the first number of a version, overwrote earlier modules' vendor lists, exited 0 after an arithmetic error on `V08`, reported an unreadable folder as success and never listed the colliding files. Zeus itself applied a single `001.sql` with no version, checksum, history or tool identity.

- `domain/migrations.py` (stdlib only): pinned `zeus-sql-migrator@1` with the filename contract `V?<n>(.<n>|_<n>)*(__<description>)?.sql`; `parse_version` normalizes to integer components (`V01`=`V1`=`001`=`V1.0`, `V1_2`=`V1.2`, `V08` is 8, `V1.10`>`V1.9`) and **refuses unsupported names by name** (never skipped); `parse_config` (module/vendor/path/required/allow_empty, target vendor, expected tables); `classify_location` (found / empty / missing / unreadable / unknown; missing and unreadable are never empty; unknown is never approval); `evaluate` yields **four separate results** — filenames (per module/vendor, duplicates list every colliding file), parity (single vendor is not applicable, an unobserved required vendor is unknown), content (empty / oversized / undecodable files named), history (per module: modified applied version, applied version without a file, out-of-order new version; foreign modules listed, not judged) — plus the live schema; `apply_allowed` only when every result is ok/not_applicable.
- `adapters/migrations.py`: `discover` on the real filesystem with exact error names; `Migrator.precheck` (read-only under the control-plane lock); `Migrator.apply` re-reads the history under the lock, refuses on any non-ok result, applies pending versions in normalized order and records `schema_migrations(module, version, checksum, name, tool, applied_at, applied_by)` in the same transaction, then verifies expected tables; a failing statement leaves no history row and no partial schema. `python -m codex_harness.adapters.migrations precheck|apply` runs as a child process printing one JSON document (exit 1 refused, 2 error).
- `application/migration_receipts.py`: `MigrationReceipts.record` binds operation, argv, config digest, root, source revision, environment, exact stdout/stderr bytes (artifacts), exit code and times; outcomes completed / refused / error / unparseable; `require_approved` admits only a completed, allowing precheck of the pinned tool bound to the same revision and environment.
- `PostgresStore.migrate()` now goes through the migrator with the packaged `resources/migrations.json` (module `core`, vendor `postgres`) and records `001`; `init-db` reports applied/already_applied/tool.
- `docs/contracts.md`: `INV-MIGRATION-001`. Record: `docs/zeus/implementation/migration-precheck-001/` (README + `target-tests.json` with 5 negative controls).

## Verification

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| `tests/test_migration_precheck.py` + `test_architecture.py` (HARNESS_INTEGRATION=1, isolated PostgreSQL schema, real files, two concurrent child processes) | 10 passed |
| `test_host_interruption.py` + `test_execution_fence.py` with the new `migrate()` (HARNESS_INTEGRATION=1) | 22 passed, 5 skipped (together with the above) |
| `tests/test_integration.py` (HARNESS_INTEGRATION=1, no Redis) | 19 failed, 7 passed, 19 errors — identical to the FA-030 branch on main; all Redis connection refusals |
| Full Windows suite (Python 3.12, PG tests skipped; on main `1488468`) | see README table |
| `uv run ruff check .` | passed |
| Negative controls (first-number-only comparison / unsupported names skipped / unreadable folder as found / modified applied version accepted / apply without the lock) | each makes the target tests fail |

## Not claimed

No Flyway engine run (Flyway is not adopted; the normalization contract is checked against this tool's own apply order); no Windows/Linux/WSL install, upgrade, interrupted recovery or data-preservation run; no money scenario or human acceptance. Windows ACL permission denial was observed only through a file-instead-of-directory error. The history table is new in this PR; on an existing DB the next `migrate()` re-executes the idempotent `001.sql` once and records it.

검토 반영 — `9ea8f8a` (P2: 다른 config의 precheck 결과 수용)

**변경**
- `adapters/migrations.py`: plan/receipt에 `root`(절대 경로)를 담습니다.
- `application/migration_receipts.py`: `record`가 stdout 문서의 `operation`과 plan/receipt의 `config_hash`·`root`를 제출 binding과 비교해 다르면 `outcome=binding_mismatch`, `binding_mismatches=[...]`로 기록(승인 불가). `require_approved(tx, id, *, source_revision, environment, config_hash, root)` — 소비자가 적용하려는 config·root를 명시해야 하고 mismatch 행은 거절.

**테스트**: 다른 config_hash로 제출한 receipt → `binding_mismatch['config_hash']`, 승인 거절; 다른 root → `['root']`; operation 불일치 → `['operation']`; 소비 시 다른 config/root 거절.

main(`66076cc`) 위로 rebase. 로컬(격리 PG + 자식 프로세스): 6 passed; Ruff 통과.

# PR #62: 변경 요청 / 병합 보류

검토 head: `571e6cef57df4b817f634fa53d1cfe1db48234c9`. Codex 독립 검토입니다.

**[P2] 다른 config의 precheck 결과를 적용 허용 증적으로 수용합니다**

run.config_hash=A, 실제 stdout.plan.config_hash=B인 receipt를 record한 뒤 require_approved하면 통과합니다. source_revision/environment/tool 비교만으로 어떤 migration config를 검사했는지는 결속되지 않습니다.

위치: [src/codex_harness/application/migration_receipts.py:53](https://github.com/trevi00/zeus/blob/571e6cef57df4b817f634fa53d1cfe1db48234c9/src/codex_harness/application/migration_receipts.py#L53)

수정·재검증 조건: stdout의 operation/config_hash와 제출 binding을 비교하고 소비 시 expected config/root/tool을 요구하세요. 다른 config/root의 성공 receipt 재사용은 거절되어야 합니다.

검증: 해당 head의 대상 검사 **14 passed in 8.12s**, Ruff 통과. 개별 대상 검사에 PostgreSQL 통합을 활성화했습니다. 통과 횟수는 파일 간 중복을 포함하므로 고유 테스트 수로 합산하지 않습니다.

실제 모델·사람 인수·실기기·재부팅 검증은 수행하지 않았습니다. PR 수용과 연결 이슈의 완료/종료는 별도입니다.
